source.title: Scramble filtering
source.content:
*DISCLAIMER:*  After the resolution of this incident, regulation [4b1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b1) has been changed to explicitely disallow scramble filtering by delegates.

There was a very lucky scramble during the 2x2x2 Cube final. A competitor got NR on that scramble, and everyone went to congratulate him. The Delegate changed the scramble group suspecting filtration of the solve. All the solves were kept.

translation.title: 筛选打乱
translation.content:
说明：此事件处理完毕后，规则 [4b1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#4b1) 已修改，明确禁止代表筛选打乱。

二阶决赛中出现了一个非常幸运的打乱。一名选手以此取得国家纪录（NR），大家都前去祝贺。代表怀疑还原情况已经泄露，因此更换了打乱组。所有还原成绩均予保留。

checks: 译文对照所提供的完整正文；保留匿名、处置及不确定性措辞。
notes: 原文使用 ‘suspecting filtration of the solve’，措辞含混；译为怀疑还原情况泄露，待独立复核。
review.scope: 仅所列官方日志正文；引用的论坛、附件和其他页面保留链接，不计作已翻译。
